name: scryer
readme_summary: Scryer is a self-hosted media management application written in Rust, designed to efficiently handle movies, TV series, and anime. It automates the process of monitoring libraries, searching for releases, evaluating quality, coordinating downloads, organizing files, and managing subtitles, all within a single, compiled binary.
key_features: Self-hosted media management for movies, TV series, and anime
Evaluates releases against quality and rules policies
Media discovery based on trends and user history
Single machine-code compiled binary for efficiency
Enhanced anime handling with multiple datasources and numbering nuances
Embedded web UI and GraphQL API
Plugin runtime for indexers, download clients, subtitle providers, and notifications
primary_use_case: Automated media library management and organization, with a particular focus on efficient handling of anime content.
cover_image_prompt: A meticulous librarian meticulously organizing a vast, magical library filled with glowing books representing movies, TV shows, and anime. The librarian uses a futuristic scanner to identify, sort, and catalog each item, with streams of data flowing from the scanner to organized shelves. Missing book covers glow faintly, indicating a need for subtitles, which the librarian then conjures with a wave of their hand. Subtle UI elements showing media titles and quality ratings are visible on the scanner screen. The 'Scryer' logo is subtly etched into the librarian's desk. The scene is set in a clean, modern library with soft, ambient lighting, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with a vibrant color palette.

name: CoolText
description: A Simple CoolText.com's Python Based API.
readme_summary: This Python library acts as a wrapper for the CoolText.com API, allowing users to programmatically generate custom text-based images. It simplifies the process of creating stylized text logos by enabling developers to specify logo styles, text content, colors, and other parameters through Python code and receive image URLs or downloaded image files.
key_features: Build typed payloads for image generation
Configuration options for logo ID, text, font size, file format, colors, and logo-specific settings
primary_use_case: Programmatically generating custom text-based images and logos using Python.
cover_image_prompt: A whimsical digital artisan, akin to a master calligrapher, sits at a futuristic workbench. Instead of ink and quill, they use glowing lines of Python code to sculpt vibrant, stylized text logos that float into existence. The input is a simple text string and a 'logo style' icon, while the output is a beautifully rendered, unique text image. Subtle UI elements showing code snippets and logo previews are integrated into the workbench. The scene is bright and creative, with a clean, modern aesthetic, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style.

name: obs-lite
description: Lightweight screen recorder for Windows with an OBS Studio-like interface: one portable .exe, hardware H.264 to MP4, desktop audio and microphone, pause, global hotkeys.
readme_summary: obs-lite is a lightweight, portable screen recording application for Windows, designed with a familiar OBS Studio-like interface. It focuses on efficient hardware H.264 encoding to MP4, capturing desktop audio and microphone input, and offers features like pause functionality and global hotkeys, all within a single executable file.
primary_use_case: A simple, efficient, and user-friendly screen recording solution for Windows users, particularly those familiar with OBS Studio, who need a portable tool for capturing video and audio without extensive setup.
cover_image_prompt: A minimalist, stylized digital artist's workbench. In the center, a sleek, compact digital easel displays a live, vibrant recording of a computer desktop. To the left, a microphone icon and a sound wave graphic are subtly integrated into the scene, representing audio input. To the right, a small, glowing MP4 file icon is being neatly placed into a digital folder labeled 'Recordings'. The overall mood is efficient and clean, with subtle glowing lines connecting the elements, hinting at the underlying technology. The repository name 'obs-lite' is subtly etched onto the easel. The style is a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, modern aesthetic and a balanced color palette.

name: universal-modder
description: Point Claude at any game. Skills, tools and the fal MCP that let Claude Code mod almost any PC game you own: recon, reverse engineering, fal-generated art/3D/audio, in-game testing, showcase videos.
readme_summary: Universal Modder is a Python-based framework that enables AI coding agents to automatically generate mods for PC games. It provides skills and tools for game recon, reverse engineering, asset creation (art, 3D, audio), in-game testing, and video generation, fostering a community for sharing and remixing mods.
key_features: AI-generated art, 3D, and audio assets using fal.ai
Shared knowledge base for AI agents
Support for multiple AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot, Cursor, OpenCode)
primary_use_case: To empower AI coding agents to automatically create mods for a wide range of PC games, simplifying the modding process and enabling creative content generation.
cover_image_prompt: A whimsical, steampunk-inspired workshop where a friendly robot arm is meticulously assembling a miniature, glowing video game world. Gears and circuits are visible, with streams of colorful data flowing from a large, stylized 'AI Brain' towards the robot. On a workbench, game controllers, stylized code snippets, and digital art assets are scattered around. The robot is placing a custom-made tree into the game world, which then illuminates. The repository name 'Universal Modder' is subtly etched onto a blueprint on the wall. The overall mood is creative and industrious, rendered in a vibrant, 3D isometric illustration style with a focus on clear visual storytelling.

name: BetterYoutube
description: A curated collection of lightweight, open-source userscripts (monkey scripts) crafted to improve and declutter your YouTube and YouTube Music browsing experience.
readme_summary: BetterYoutube is a collection of JavaScript userscripts designed to enhance the YouTube and YouTube Music experience by decluttering the interface and preventing common annoyances. It offers lightweight solutions to issues like video pausing and hidden playlists.
key_features: Improves YouTube and YouTube Music browsing experience
Restores hidden queues in Mixes and playlists
primary_use_case: To enhance the user experience on YouTube and YouTube Music by providing unobtrusive script-based modifications that fix common annoyances and declutter the interface.
cover_image_prompt: A digital librarian meticulously organizing a vast, chaotic library of video reels. One reel is about to fall and display a 'paused' icon, but the librarian quickly places a glowing 'play' symbol on it, keeping it active. Another section of the library has hidden shelves that are now revealed, showing a vibrant playlist of upcoming videos. Subtle UI elements and data streams flow around the librarian, representing the userscripts. The scene is set in a clean, modern digital archive with soft, focused lighting. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with clear iconography and a clean, organized composition, emphasizing the 'BetterYoutube' name subtly integrated into the library's signage.

name: kharos
description: Многопользовательская браузерная RTS: процедурная карта, экономика и логистика, бой. Графика и звук синтезируются кодом, без ассетов.
readme_summary: Kharos is a multiplayer browser-based RTS game built with Luau and Rust, featuring procedural map generation, complex economy and logistics systems, and tactical combat. It emphasizes a unique 'pixel art without assets' approach where graphics and sound are synthesized by code.
key_features: Procedural map generation with multiple biomes and terrain effects
Asset-less pixel art generated by shaders and code
In-depth economy: resource extraction, processing, and logistics
Tactical combat with unit classes, defenses, and fog of war
Technology tree for unlocking new buildings and abilities
Advanced logistics: truck routing, cargo management, and dropships
Synthesized sound and music generated by code
Responsive UI for mobile and tablet devices
Modding support for game mechanics, UI, and audio
primary_use_case: A real-time strategy game playable in a web browser, focusing on base building, resource management, logistics, and combat with procedural generation and unique code-generated visuals.
cover_image_prompt: A vibrant, isometric view of a bustling, futuristic RTS base being constructed on a procedurally generated alien planet. A central 'Founder Machine' (MCV) is deploying modular structures like mines, refineries, and factories, connected by glowing energy conduits. Small autonomous drones and trucks are actively transporting resources between these buildings. In the distance, a diverse landscape with distinct biomes (e.g., rocky deserts and lush alien flora) stretches towards a horizon with dynamic weather effects like dust storms. Subtle UI elements showing resource counts and a mini-map are integrated into the scene. The overall aesthetic is clean, colorful, and hints at the 'synthesized' nature of the game's visuals, with the repository name 'Kharos' subtly etched onto a central structure. Style: 3D isometric illustration, vibrant colors, clean lines, high detail.
